_comment: Canonical EXPECTED model for the Royco DAY AccessManager (0x87aED46566cb28c8375cfcC9971090882A0fB12e on 1/42161/8453), keyed by role name. Authored from royco-day script/deploy/config/RoleGraphConfig.sol + DeployCore/DeployPeriphery grants; verified against mainnet on-chain state 2026-08-12. All grant delays are 0 in the Day graph. delaySeconds: Immediate=0, 24h=86400, 72h=259200. Actor names must match the day manager's actors[] in catalog.<chainId>.json.

ADMIN_ROLE.description: OZ AccessManager root admin. FNDN at the non-cancellable 72h delay ('kerchkoffs lockdown'); the RoycoFactoryGatekeeper co-holds at 0 so fresh-target configuration flows through it rather than the factory.

PUBLIC_ROLE.description: Open role — every address is auto-member. Bound to permissionless surfaces: executeMarketDeployment on the Day factory, entry-point LP selectors, kernel sync/reinvest.

ADMIN_PAUSER_ROLE.description: Pauses every Day protocol contract and Balancer pool. Sole holder is the dedicated 1/4 WAY_PAUSE multisig, immediate.

ADMIN_UNPAUSER_ROLE.description: Unpauses Day protocol contracts and Balancer pools. FNDN-only, immediate.

ADMIN_UPGRADER_ROLE.description: UUPS upgrades of the Day factory, entry point, and market syncer. WAY at 72h, GUARDIAN-cancellable.

ST_LP_ROLE.description: Senior tranche LP ops (deposit, redeem) on Day markets.

JT_LP_ROLE.description: Junior tranche LP ops (deposit, redeem) on Day markets.

LPT_LP_ROLE.description: Liquidity-provider tranche LP ops (deposit, redeem, multi-asset variants) on Day markets. The Day factory co-holds so market deployment can seed the LP tranche.

BURNER_ROLE.description: Bound to tranche burn/burnFrom but never granted — burning is reserved for a future authorized burner.

ADMIN_KERNEL_ROLE.description: Kernel parameter updates (protocol fee recipient, senior self-liquidation bonus). WAY at 72h.

ADMIN_MARKET_OPS_ROLE.description: Market operations: kernel blacklist pointer, accountant dust tolerance. WAY at 72h.

ADMIN_ACCOUNTANT_ROLE.description: Accountant parameter updates (YDMs, coverage, liquidity, yield shares, fixed-term duration). WAY at 72h.

ADMIN_ORACLE_ROLE.description: Kernel pricing config (BPT oracle, collateral oracle, reinvestment slippage, sequencer feed). WAY at 72h; FNDN co-holds at 0 as the emergency oracle path.

ADMIN_ENTRY_POINT_ROLE.description: Entry-point tranche-config tuning and syncer kernel registration. WAY at the 24h tier; the Gatekeeper co-holds at 0 for market-periphery configuration during deployment.

ADMIN_ENTRY_POINT_ROLE_CLAIM_FEE.description: Collects entry-point protocol fees. FNDN-only, immediate.

ADMIN_BALANCER_POOL_MANAGER_ROLE.description: Balancer pool management: static swap fee, pool-creator fee percentages and withdrawal. WAY, immediate.

ADMIN_FACTORY_ROLE.description: Template registration on the Day factory. Held by the deployer during bootstrap only and renounced afterwards (verified revoked on-chain); expected empty in steady state. Guardian stays at the OZ default (ADMIN_ROLE) — the role was never in ApplyRoleGraph's setRoleGuardian pass.

LP_ROLE_ADMIN_ROLE.description: Meta-role: admin of ST/JT/LPT LP roles, so LP allowlisting bypasses the 72h ADMIN_ROLE path. WAY and AUTO (Autonomous, contracted service provider) co-hold, immediate.

GUARDIAN_ROLE.description: Cancels delayed operations on every operational role. Co-held by FNDN (root) and FNDN_VETO (dedicated 1/4 fast-veto multisig).
